sources.content: A Boise-area rock climbing gym will close its doors later this year after more than a decade, citing leasing disagreements with the property manager and difficulty finding a new space. Asana shared an FAQ document online to address questions about memberships, future operations and other concerns, as well as a timeline for anticipated changes. The company did not respond to a request for comment on the leasing agreement with Asana or its future plans for the building. Sproull said he also looked for a new location for the gym during the lease process and came up empty-handed due to the niche zoning and height requirements needed to house the climbing gym or the “significantly higher lease rates” at plausible locations.
